description: Public transport travel time matrices for GB is a data set deposited in University of Glasgow by its authors Urban Big Data Centre. The data is available on demand, contact ubdc-dataservices@glasgow.ac.uk to request access to the data. This dataset provides ready-to-use door-to-door public transport travel time estimates for each of the 230,000 2011 Census output areas (OA) in Great Britain (GB) to every other OA reachable within 150 minutes during the morning peak for the year 2023. Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
